title: DarGlobal Investor FAQs & Purchase Guidelines
raw_content:
Frequently Asked Questions

Can foreign investors purchase freehold property with DarGlobal?

Yes. DarGlobal developments in Dubai (UAE), Oman, Qatar, and Spain are located in designated freehold investment zones, allowing 100% foreign ownership for international buyers of all nationalities.

Are property buyers eligible for Golden Visas or residency?

Yes. Properties meeting qualifying investment thresholds (such as AED 2,000,000 in the UAE or real estate thresholds in Oman and Spain) qualify the owner and their immediate family for long-term Golden Visas and residency permits subject to government guidelines.

What payment plans are offered?

DarGlobal offers phased construction-linked payment plans with milestone-based installments, typically structured as a 10% to 20% down payment, periodic milestone payments during construction, and completion balance upon handover.

Where can I verify DarGlobal's corporate registration?

DarGlobal PLC is registered in England and Wales and listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange under ticker DAR, with corporate disclosures available via LSE regulatory news service.
